narrative.overview: A clean, production-grade Material Design 3 system built on Vuetify 4: flat bordered surfaces, one indigo accent, generous whitespace on an 8px rhythm, and elevation that appears only on interaction. The win condition is calm consistency, not visual spectacle; when in doubt, do less.
keyCharacteristics: Two quiet surfaces only: white and light gray.
One brand color, indigo, used as a function.
Borders over shadows: cards are flat at rest.
Motion is transform and opacity only, self-guarded for reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is rare on purpose. One primary call to action per view, plus links, focus and active states.

rules.name: The Two Surfaces Rule
rules.body: A page is built from white and light gray. No third tinted surface, no gradient surface, no saturated section band.

rules.name: The Feedback Stays Feedback Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only on status.

rules.name: The Borders Over Shadows Rule
rules.body: At rest, separation is a border. A shadow at rest is a defect; a shadow on hover is the intended signal.

rules.name: The Decorations Stay Inside Their Shape Rule
rules.body: Accent bars on rounded cards use overflow hidden and a pseudo-element, never a raw one-sided border.

dos: Do use tokens from src/styles/variables.scss and semantic Vuetify names.
Do keep cards flat and bordered at rest, and let elevation appear on hover.
Do apply the same hover to every peer in a grid.
Do guard every animation with prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent color, a gradient surface, a gradient text, or a glow.
Don't use feedback colors as decoration.
Don't hardcode colors, spacings or font sizes.
